verdict.rationale: Orb is an API-driven billing platform, so scoped or least-privilege API credentials are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers the API's idempotency, pagination, SDKs and webhooks, but never mentions API key creation, permission scopes, or restricted credentials for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
